findings.body: After the picker returns, the statement path calls `statementRequest` without the validated plant filter. That helper still derives one plant from the user's entire scope, so a reader granted several plants who chooses even one plant is refused for ambiguous plant scope instead of receiving the period choice; choosing several plants likewise cannot execute. The Tasks table assigns plant-to-period and multi-plant statement continuation to MP-ASK-STATEMENT.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-STATEMENT must carry chosen plants into statement continuation

findings.body: This branch emits `plantChoice`, but the unchanged client has no `plantChoice` rendering, non-empty validation, or request `origin`; `use-ask.ts` still sends continuations as only `{ question, selection }`. Consequently users cannot choose plants, see the required live-region error, or submit `plant-choice`/`period-choice` origins yet. The Tasks table assigns this work to MP-ASK-UI-CHOICE.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-UI-CHOICE must render and submit the plant picker

This remaining Done-when 9 work is assigned to MP-SAVED-PINS.
